- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Both traditional hand washing and hand sanitizer are effective methods of hand hygiene against harmful bacteria.

- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Hand sanitizer is useful when soap and water are not readily available and can effectively eliminate most types of harmful bacteria on the hands.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] It is recommended to use both methods of hand hygiene for optimal protection against harmful bacteria.
- [USER] User expressed that hand sanitizer is more convenient and faster to use.
- [USER] User mentioned not having time to wash hands every time they touch something.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Hand sanitizer is generally more convenient and faster to use compared to traditional hand washing.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Hand sanitizer is effective in killing most types of harmful bacteria found on hands.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] If hands are visibly dirty or greasy, hand sanitizer may not be as effective, and washing with soap and water is recommended.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Proper hand hygiene, including both hand washing and hand sanitizer use, is essential for reducing the spread of germs and protecting against illness.
